recommendations.title: Capitalize on positive MRR momentum with targeted expansion
recommendations.description: MRR is growing 13.3% above baseline and showing positive momentum. This is the right time to validate what's driving growth and consider scaling the successful channels.
recommendations.expected_impact: Could accelerate MRR to 20%+ monthly growth if successful channels are identified and scaled
specific_actions: Analyze new customer cohorts from past 2 weeks - identify acquisition sources (channels, campaigns, customer profile)
Interview 5-10 new customers to understand what attracted them and drove conversion
If specific channel/profile identified, increase GTM spend on that channel by 2-3x over next 4 weeks
Track CAC and LTV for new cohort vs historical average to validate unit economics

recommendations.title: Stabilize D30 retention rate with proactive engagement
recommendations.description: D30 retention at 38.7% is stable but below ideal (40%+). Even small improvements in retention compound significantly over time and reduce CAC payback period.
recommendations.expected_impact: Each 5-point retention improvement compounds to 10-15% incremental ARR over 12 months
specific_actions: Run retention cohort analysis - identify which user segments have lowest D30 retention
Conduct exit interviews with churned users (target 10 interviews) to identify primary churn reasons
Design 2-3 lightweight intervention experiments (e.g., in-product onboarding, email campaign, feature highlight) targeting lowest-retention segment
Run experiments for 2 weeks, measure impact on D30 retention

risk_summary: Overall health is solid (68/100) with balanced performance across dimensions. Positive momentum in MRR growth presents opportunity to validate and scale successful channels. D30 retention is stable but has room for improvement - even small gains will compound significantly. Financial position is healthy (8.2 months runway) providing runway to invest in growth. No critical risks at this time; recommend capitalizing on positive signals while maintaining focus on retention fundamentals.
